name: Starship Engines Crippled
description: Rogue Trader, Table 8-12, result 6 (p. 222). How badly the plasma drives were hit. Also used when the Flank Speed Extended Action fails by two or more degrees.

results.name: Drives Damaged
results.text: The plasma drives are still usable, though heavily damaged. Speed is halved. Repairable.

results.name: Drives Wrecked
results.text: The drives are completely wrecked. Speed drops to 1. Repairable.
